'''Oulanne''' was a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
During a mission for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|special operative]] team, including [[Jan Ors]], stole a cargo of prime-grade [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] [[Slug/Legends|slugs]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the jungles of Oulanne. During the mission, Ors contracted a type of disease from the jungles that infected her right leg, causing delirium.
